notes: Die Kollektion's pack manifest: what the pack holds and how the game should group it.
It follows the game's official livery manifest (strict JSON: no comments, no trailing commas; `notes` fields carry comments) and extends it with the pack, its groups, its vehicles and its patches.
Paths are relative to the repository root. `make pack` builds the shareable zip from this file; `make check` validates it.

groups.notes: A merchant section of its own, cloned from the donor's category (planned; today the trucks sit in the donor's category).

patches.notes: Portal axles, coil springs, side-exit exhaust and more steering lock on the stock Mammoth.
The canary: a golf bag strapped to the roof of The Ding, a starter vehicle.
